The problem

Every small request is a phone call.

“What is the Wi-Fi password?”Guests ask the front desk again and again.
“What is on the menu?”They do not know the dishes, prices or timings.
“Can you send extra towels?”Staff stop what they are doing to take the call.

Every call slows your team down. One tap answers all three.

The idea

Tap the card. The hotel opens.

One smart card in every room, with a QR code on the same card as a backup. Guests never download anything.

Ordering

Four taps from table to kitchen.

  • 1
    Tap the card or scan the QR code
  • 2
    Pick dishes with + and −
  • 3
    Add name and table or room number
  • 4
    Tap SendWhatsApp or SMS opens with the order ready.
